description.value: Homeslice Cafe & Bakery is a family-owned, made-from-scratch bakery on the outskirts of the Kerrisdale neighbourhood in Vancouver. The shop produces breads, loaves, and other baked goods, with pre-orders available online and walk-in shopping during regular business hours. Cyclists passing through the Kerrisdale/Arbutus corridor will find it a welcoming stop for fresh-baked provisions.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 9m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 23m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 82m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at homesliceyvr.ca clearly confirms this is a real, open family-owned bakery at 5335 West Boulevard, Vancouver, with a phone number (604) 423-3668 and email found on the /contact-us page. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields remain null. The OSM shop=bakery tag matched to 'Groceries' is a loose fit; the business is a specialty bakery/cafe rather than a general grocery, which is flagged as a concern but not grounds for exclusion.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; (604) 423-3668 was sourced from the website's contact page and is used as the listing phone.

Category assigned as Groceries via shop=bakery tag, but the business is a specialty artisan bakery/cafe rather than a general grocery — consider recategorizing if directory supports a Bakery or Cafe category.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bakery with an active website, confirmed address, and walk-in retail; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Kerrisdale area.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery was matched to Groceries, but this is a specialty artisan bakery/cafe, not a general grocery store. Category may be better listed as Cafe or Bakery if such categories exist in the directory.
